top.title: Asian Bond Yields Rise Despite Oil Decline as Caution Reigns
top.summary: The selloff in U.S. government bonds spilled over into Asian debt markets, but oil fell as traders weighed reports of a potential proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

top.title: The Robust U.S. Economy Powers Through Rate Hikes and Rising Bond Yields
top.summary: AI-driven growth looks resistant to higher borrowing costs, spooking Treasury investors.

top.title: Singapore Dollar Consolidates; Fed Rate-Hike Prospects Could Weigh
top.summary: The Singapore dollar consolidated against its U.S. counterpart, but prospects of rate increases by the Federal Reserve could weigh on the Asian currency.

top.title: Surging Treasury yields pose a brand new problem for Kevin Warsh and the Fed
top.summary: Markets expect the central bank will take a firmer hand on inflation. It's not that easy.

top.title: Japanese government bond yields hit new high as global sell-off continues
top.summary: Sharp increase in interest rate expectations across advanced economies, says Capital Economics

top.title: Gold Falls Amid Expectations for Fed Rate Increase
top.summary: Gold fell. The precious metal remained under pressure as higher oil prices and resilient U.S. activity data reinforce expectations that the Fed might need to keep its policy tighter for longer, ANZ said.
